chunks: Do not set up another god with God. I give you a clear warning from Him.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Do not set up another god with God' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Adh-Dhariyat, this verse reinforces the core tenet of Tawhid by commanding the exclusion of any rival to Allah, a theme central to Shia theological discourse on divine unity. It highlights the Prophet's role as a clear warner (nathir), linking the rejection of shirk to the eschatological accountability emphasized throughout the chapter. This serves as a foundational reminder for believers to maintain pure monotheism in both belief and practice.
